title: 字节序判定与 htonl 手写实现
expected_output:
=== endianness ===
  v = 0x01020304 stored as bytes: 04 03 02 01
  this machine is little-endian
  the byte at the LOWEST address is 04, i.e. the LEAST significant byte of v

=== htonl written by hand ===
  my_htonl(0x01020304) = 0x04030201  -> bytes 01 02 03 04 (big-endian order)
  on a little-endian host htonl is a plain byte swap: yes
  double htonl(htonl(v)) cancels out: yes

=== byte strings are never swapped ===
  "AB" bytes: 41 42  (a char array has no multi-byte scalar to reorder)

=== practical rule ===
  every multi-byte field written to a file or a socket needs an explicit byte order
  never write a raw struct: padding, endianness and version all leak into the format
